Corollary
[Time derivative of distance under Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0063 ↗ lem:chow-iii-forward-distance-derivative 1. ch18:18.2\group Changing Distances

If $g(t)$ is a complete Ricci flow, then \[ \left.\frac{\partial ^-}{\partial t}\right|_{t=t_0}d_{g(t)}(x,x_0) =\min _{\eta \in \mathcal Z(t_0)} \left(-\int _\eta \Ric _{g(t_0)}(\eta ',\eta ')\, \dd s\right). \]
Proof

\sketch Substitute $\partial _tg=-2\Ric $ in Lemma 1.

□
